name: Fresno Bulldogs
description: Primarily Mexican American criminal street and prison gang based in Fresno, California, founded in 1984. One of the biggest drug gangs in Central California with an estimated 5,000 to 6,000 members. Engaged in drug trafficking, human trafficking, murder, and other crimes. Unaffiliated with Sureños or Norteños, and rivals with multiple prison gangs.
